_about: Areas tinted on the ground, for the food map to come. Each zone: id, name, colour (ground tint), edge (outline), and its outline as 'file' (a list of {lat, lon}) or 'ring' (a list of [lat, lon]). Add 金雞母, 大田寮, 大學城, 水源街 here when their outlines are known. Tints show on open ground; roads, paths and lawns keep their own colours.
